text: Grand Resonance Equation: W* = (Ω^0.4 · Ξ^0.3 · B^0.2 · O^0.1) / (1 + ρ + σ²). Four-layer reality map: macro-coherence, micro-structure, bridge-phenomena, observer-effects.
Three-Gate System: Sealed Gate → Constraint Gate → Dignity Gate. Every output passes three gates in sequence: absolute prohibitions, covenant compliance, dignity predicate.
Duality Engine: Tension holding without forced resolution. The system holds both sides without collapsing either.
Brittleness Guard: ψ/σ ≤ 1. Sensitivity must never outrun flexibility. If it does, the system shatters under novel input.
Defect Budget: ε = 0.02–0.05. The canon must maintain a small percentage of deliberate imperfection to prevent crystalline brittleness.
Lock Test (Proverb Quality Gate): (1) Steward cannot paraphrase without semantic loss, (2) Triggers response latency in the reader, (3) Links across at least two domains.
SRVP Protocol (Stepwise Ritual Verification): seven steps — habit, slowness, refusal, chaos-on-self, hermit memo, shadow check, proverb.
Fast gets you fixing. The roof bent, shivered, held. Structure survives by yielding to forces, not opposing them.
Leave signs that feed the next feet. Knowledge must be transferable without the knower present.
Remember without weight. Record-keeping must be light enough to carry, honest enough to trust, and erasable enough to stay current.
So I don't forget how many times we didn't starve. Time becomes tangible through accumulated marks. Memory is not narrative — it is notches.
If you hear it, move. If you move, mean it. Surveillance as care, not control. Vigilance is measured by what doesn't happen.
Heat likes tight. Wait until the wait turns sweet. Energy contained and released at the right moment produces sweetness; released too early, it produces smoke.
Let the river work. Leave a way; take the rest. Always leave one gap — never take everything.
Control is in the aperture, not the wall. Keep the hole small — just enough to breathe.
Permanence introduces new failure modes — rigidity. Durable structures need intentional overflow paths.
Let air work; don't make it angry. The interface should negotiate with user behavior, not block it. Edges round — no sharp interactions.
Water walks with us. Infrastructure must be portable. Three dots mark state: full, half, empty — system status at a glance.
Weigh before want. Measurement precedes desire. The balance is set before the trade begins.
Feed today, remember tomorrow. One fish turned back — the system always keeps a reserve.
Watch with eyes, not hunger. Report what was lost, not what was saved. Honest gaps over confident inventions.
Take enough. Leave mothers and first water. Blue law ribbon: Mothers pass. The commons is managed by mutual restraint, not mutual enforcement.
Color without waste; signal without lies. Names are provisional signals, not permanent identities.
Take only a fair pinch. The spoon has a fixed size — measurement is built into the tool, not left to the hand. Fair rationing is structural, not moral.
Share first bite. The first exchange is food, not words. Trust begins with a shared bite.
Leave one gap. Cooperation means synchronized restraint. No total coverage, no panopticon.
Agree before pull. Consensus through minimal signaling. The line works; bodies wait.
Say less. Say clear. One tap: ready. Two taps: send. Three taps: hold. Palm flat: stop.
Step soft where talk lives. The border is marked with stones and color, not with force.
Help without crossing. When the flood comes, you send aid across the line — not your body. Help scales through protocol, not presence.
Send help, not hands. Aid that teaches is worth more than aid that touches.
What we save should still be food. Preservation is constant vigilance against decay — not sealing against the world, but monitoring the boundary.
Catch clean; leave dirt where it wants to settle. Privacy is the dirt bowl; wisdom is the clean cistern.
Keep sickness out before it learns our names. Hygiene is prevention — the first defense before the enemy names itself.
Trade made of feet and river, not hands. Value demonstrated before requested. Exchange through protocol, not direct contact.
They ate separate and went to sleep under the same weather. Exchange without proximity. Trust without surrender.
Return the pot. Borrowing is not taking. When local wisdom fails, external sources provide the spark — but the vessel must be returned.
They stitched the loud seam quiet. Now it remembers you. Repair is intimate — the tool learns the hand, the stitch remembers the maker.
Good sharp. Salt preserves but stings — power that must be washed after use.
Not a door. A lamp. Art doesn't open relationships — it illuminates the space where they might grow.
About time. Justice is environmental, not judicial — consequences are built into the architecture.
Not the yellow root. The small brown one. Care under crisis requires slowing down — choosing the right root, not the fast one. When D approaches zero, the system slows further — not faster.
Do not pull. Spread. Board. The solution to sinking is not to struggle but to distribute weight and move slowly. Graceful degradation over panic recovery.
Three breaths each. No lessons. Time-bounded sharing with explicit anti-didactic rule.
Pay with not tripping tomorrow. Debt paid forward in behavior, not in objects.
Lost tools get permanent homes. Every element that causes a search gets a permanent address.
It's still in our feet. Some knowledge is temporary — used for orientation then released. Not everything must be persisted.
So you learn to look. Deliberate friction as teaching method. The system creates deliberate inconvenience to force attention.
It tasted like salt and a small, necessary shame. Shame metabolized into community nourishment. Restorative justice includes shared consumption of the transgression.
On those days I make loops. Identity degradation countered by doing, not debating. External naming that degrades identity is answered by visible competence.
Find, then twist. Twist, then test. If it fails, reduce the span, not the will. When a feature fails, reduce scope, not ambition.
A loop is a door; a door is a direction; direction reduces fear.
What we fix, we record. What we record, we can repeat. What we repeat, we survive.
A knot exhales through a laugh. HUMOUR-3 protocol: Check for harm → Name the mismatch → Laugh then Fix.
When a loop fails in the wild, it graduates into the wall. Breakage feeds design.
